title: K. al-Manāhij ('Book of Methods')

date.basis: MK: 'completed on' this date in Natanz; the same day and place as the Majlis 10196 colophon (ff. 382b-404a); the folio lies in the second half, whose dates MK assumes are more likely composition (p.79); not asterisked.

addressee: His son Muḥammad, for whom it was written
manuscript: 5 items listed; earliest dated: MS Majlis 10196 ff. 382b-404a (Natanz, 20 Rajab 833/14 April 1430); Sipahsālār MS 2930/12 (Abarquh, 845/1441); three Tehran microfilms (undated).
summary: A minutely detailed treatise on logic in the manner of the latter-day philosophers, in four methods; in the main contemporary but at points preferring the ancients.
